nodes.description: Integrates facility inventory records into a global inventory management view.
Introduces formal operating policies for picking and storing workflows.
Adds quantity-aware collecting, fill-aware placement, box fill limits, and building-specific outbound thresholds.
Unlocks temperature readings for buildings, facilities, containers, and items, along with the temperature grid overlay.
Unlocks refrigeration facilities and the operating tools needed to qualify for cold-chain handling.
Allows buildings to let human workers remove EVA suits after entering through an airlock. Suitless workers work faster but consume indoor oxygen and take damage in critically low oxygen.
